tldr: Neptune in the 7th house: longing becomes personal through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
body:
With Neptune in the 7th house, this part of you sensitizes partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict. Neptune describes longing, imagination, sensitivity, compassion, confusion, and the places where boundaries soften. In practice, this brings attention to the one-to-one dynamics that show you how you meet others and how you let yourself be met.

When this placement is supported, relationship patterns can become clearer while there is still room to choose differently. Neptune can become empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said.

When it is strained, you may hand too much power to the other person or make them carry the whole story. The harder pattern can show up as avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence.
gift: empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said expressed through partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
challenge: avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence around partners, close relationships, agreements, clients, and conflict.
